import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('fhwa_vehicle_miles_by_functional_system_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
# States start at row 15 (index 14) and end before 'U.S. Total'
us_idx = df[df[0] == 'U.S. Total'].index[0]
states_df = df.iloc[14:us_idx].copy()
states_df[17] = pd.to_numeric(states_df[17], errors='coerce')
top3 = states_df.sort_values(by=17, ascending=False).head(3)
result = top3[0].tolist()

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('fhwa_vehicle_miles_by_functional_system_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)

ca_rural = float(df[df[0] == 'California'].iloc[0, 8])

result = 'California' if ca_rural > tx_rural else 'Texas'
